'''Slave Quarters Row''', commonly known as the '''Mos Espa Slave Quarters''', was a crowded section of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

Slave Quarters Row was situated on the outskirts of the spaceport, and was one of Mos Espa's poorest areas. The row was lined with cheap hovels originally built by the mining companies who first colonized Tatooine. These hovels were home to slaves of such prominent Mos Espa figures as [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla the Elder]] and the junk-dealer [[Watto/Legends|Watto]]. The hovels used outdated bio-converter power generators that converted sludge from the underground pipelines into [[Natchgas/Legends|natchgas]] to fuel the hovels' limited power needs.

[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] lived out his childhood years with [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|his mother]] in Slave Quarters Row, along with his friends [[Kitster Chanchani Banai]], [[W. Wald]], [[Amee/Legends|Amee]],
[[Melee/Legends|Melee]], [[Seek/Legends|Seek]] and [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]]. The Skywalker hovel was a conglomerate of three separate hovels, though this was not generosity on their master Watto's part; the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] simply could not afford any more slaves to fill his hovels.

In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] visited Slave Quarters during the search for the famous and missing moss painting ''[[Killik Twilight]]''.

[[File:ITW1_Anakins_hovel.jpg|thumb|180px|The Skywalker hovel cutaway]]

==Behind the scenes==
The real-world locations for the ''Slave Quarters'' are [[Ksar Hadada]], [[Ksar Medenine]] and [[Ksar Ouled Soltane]] in [[Tunisia]].
